import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Any opioid section starts around row 67
# 2017 is column T (index 19)
# Male age-adjusted is row 82 (index 81)

female_rate = float(df.iloc[93, 19])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Synthetic opioids other than methadone section: rows 261 to 269 (indices 260 to 268)
# 2017 is column T (index 19)
age_rows = df.iloc[260:269, [0, 19]].copy()
age_rows[19] = pd.to_numeric(age_rows[19], errors='coerce')
result = age_rows.loc[age_rows[19].idxmax(), 0]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Heroin section: row 322 (index 321) is 'All ages, age adjusted\2'
# 1999 is col B (index 1), 2017 is col T (index 19)
rate_1999 = float(df.iloc[321, 1])
rate_2017 = float(df.iloc[321, 19])
result = round(rate_2017 - rate_1999, 2)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Methadone section, crude rate across all people is row 197 (index 196)
# Years are in row 5 (index 4) or row 194 (index 193)
years = df.iloc[193, 1:20].astype(str).str.strip()
rates = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[196, 1:20], errors='coerce')
s = pd.Series(rates.values, index=years.values)
result = str(s.idxmax())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_overdose_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Natural or semisynthetic opioids section: rows 135 to 143 (indices 134 to 142)
# 2017 is column T (index 19)
age_rows = df.iloc[134:143, [0, 19]].copy()
age_rows[19] = pd.to_numeric(age_rows[19], errors='coerce')
top3 = age_rows.sort_values(by=19, ascending=False).head(3)
